title: Dialpad Review (2026)
intro: Dialpad is evaluated here as a cloud business phone system — Dialpad is an AI-centred business communications platform. Dialpad Connect is the core cloud phone scored here (Standard $15, Pro $25 annual per user/month; Enterprise custom). Support (~$80+) and Sell (~$39+) are separate products and are not treated as the Connect entry floor. AI transcription and summaries are included on Connect; power dialer depth lives on Sell, and stronger CRM/CTI starts on Pro+. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s business-communications methodology (ease of use, voice/messaging quality, routing and workflows, integrations, analytics, outbound tools, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Dialpad when included AI on the phone licence matters as much as calling itself, and Connect Standard’s $15 annual floor fits the team size.
verdict: Choose Dialpad when included AI on the phone licence matters as much as calling itself, and Connect Standard’s $15 annual floor fits the team size. Compare RingCentral for broader UCaaS+contact-centre scale, Aircall for CRM/CTI-led mid-market phone, Zoom for meetings-first bundles, and Nextiva for clearer SMB published Core floors. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Dialpad Connect is packaged for fast cloud-phone adoption with modern apps and a 14-day trial. Multi-product tabs (Connect/Support/Sell) add buying complexity. Score reflects documented onboarding posture, not hands-on lab testing.
Connect delivers solid cloud phone, SMS, team messaging and video with AI transcription on the call surface. Strong voice/messaging envelope short of RingCentral’s full UCaaS+contact-centre breadth.

Business call routing and IVR-style workflows are first-party Connect strengths; Support ladder adds contact-centre depth as a separate product. Scored on Connect routing, not assuming Support packaging.
Native Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Slack, Zoom and Google Workspace connectors are real, with deeper CTI on Pro+. Broad but slightly narrower than RingCentral/Teams ecosystem gravity.
Conversation analytics and AI-derived insights are a Dialpad hallmark, with reporting that benefits from included transcription/summaries. Score grounded in published AI analytics positioning.
SMS and Connect outbound calling cover day-to-day sales calling; power-dialer depth requires Sell. Solid outbound for Connect buyers, with a clear upsell path for dialer-heavy teams.
Pro and Enterprise (100-user minimum) plus Support/Sell ladders cover growth, though product fragmentation and seat minimums create friction versus a single RingEX-style suite.

Connect Standard at $15/user/month annual with included AI transcription/summaries is a strong published floor versus RingCentral’s medium-confidence Core ~$20, tempered by Pro minimums and separate Sell/Support spend if those jobs matter. Affiliate economics excluded.

Highest AI score in this Priority-1 set: transcription and summaries are included on Connect rather than sold only as add-ons — Dialpad’s clearest differentiator against RingCentral and Nextiva packaging.

faq.question: Is Dialpad a business phone system?
faq.answer: Yes. Dialpad is a cloud business phone system: virtual numbers, inbound and outbound calling, softphone apps and call routing. It is not a CRM of record — keep your CRM and connect it for call logging.

faq.question: How is Dialpad priced?
faq.answer: Dialpad Connect: Standard $15/user/mo annual ($27 monthly), Pro $25 annual ($35 monthly, 3-user min), Enterprise custom (100-user min). Support from ~$80 and Sell from ~$39 are separate products. AI transcription/summaries included on Connect. 14-day trial. Medium confidence — pricing page is product-tab heavy; floors cross-checked 2026-08-17.

faq.question: Does Dialpad have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: No free plan is published. A free trial is documented (about 14 days). Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Dialpad?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
